title: Night of shifting timelines in an LA Airbnb

tellings.quote: mantra I'm telling myself. I get in the shower and I'm kind of like trying to wind down and I hear that voice say, "Timelines

plain: During a strange night in a rented Airbnb home in Los Angeles around 2024 or 2025, a man heard a voice speak the word "Timelines" while he showered. Brent Friedman, a guest on an episode about Hollywood and UFOs, says it happened to him: he was repeating a calming mantra to himself and trying to wind down when the voice spoke. He tells it as part of a night when he felt timelines were shifting around him.
